summary: Connect the existing Firebase-linked GA4 stream to browser-local opt-in workspace page counts.

api.reason: The browser preference and fixed page measurements use no workspace API and generate no Firestore reads or writes.
api.permissions: Live members can opt in on each production site origin. Signed-out and demo sessions do not load the tag.

metrics.reason: Dynatrace metrics are unchanged. GA4 page counts are a separate browser-only usage signal.

traces.reason: The analytics frame adds no backend requests and does not join application traces.

logs.reason: Google Analytics receives fixed page categories. No application logs or private fields are exported.

businessEvents.reason: Page views do not describe a committed business mutation or create an outbox entry.

deploymentEvents.reason: The usual release workflow and Dynatrace deployment receipts apply independently of GA4 collection.

manualVerification: Review the opt-in and opt-out on narrow and wide viewports. Verify an isolated browser emits an allowlisted page view without the parent URL or referrer, then check production Hosting headers and Google Analytics transport separately from property Realtime visibility. Existing public captures do not show the About subsection.
